 Fixed several issues with the loot spawns,
 Fixed loot not despawning on the ground,

 Holstered weapons will lose their magazine when you log out and back in

notes.title: Welcome to the Swiss Alps! 🏔️
notes.content:
A Breathtaking Journey Awaits…
Ah, the crisp mountain air! The distant clang of a cowbell! The scenic trails winding through the untouched snowbanks of charming alpine villages! Welcome to Silent North, where every visitor is greeted with open arms…

Just maybe not the ones you’d want.
Whether you're an outdoors enthusiast, an amateur survivalist, or simply a fan of "minding your own business in an abandoned ski lodge," our little slice of high-altitude heaven has something for everyone.

Silent North wil launch in Early Access Alpha today, April 8th 2025 19:00 CET / 10 am PT. Don't miss ou t on the first week 15% launch discount!

🧭 Explore Rustic Villages 
Step into history as you wander through quaint hamlets where time — and if you’re lucky, the residents — has stood still. Step into weather-worn cabins, admire handcrafted furniture, and maybe, just maybe, discover who (or what) left their gear behind.
Be sure to say hello to the locals! They may not say much, but they'll leave an impression. \
Sometimes on your arm. 
Sometimes on your back.

🥾 Meet Fellow Travelers!
Silent North is all about forging new connections. Who knows—your next best friend might be hiding in the treeline (...possibly trailing you while aiming at your backpack).
Remember: in the Alps, sharing is caring… but so is not getting shot.

🔥 Embrace the Great Outdoors
Camp under the stars, cook what you can catch, and enjoy nature’s silence—interrupted only by faint groans, gunfire, and the occasional scream carried on the wind. Pure magic!

🏔️ Survival Never Looked So Picturesque
Towering peaks. Blood on snow. Aurora borealis. Your next postcard moment is just around the corner—and so is your next enemy. Or ally. Or both. There’s only one way to find out!


Does it sound amazing? Great! Here are some quick tips (potentially spoiler-like, you know, if you like exploring all on your own).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45100699/2be8cd0b6e696b4918c92e9e423aea358d331a1f.png

How to Get Started

Silent North can be a challenge at first. Make sure to take time to learn the basic controls. Open the map, see where you are, and make sure not to explore the snowy regions until you find something to keep you warm.Bigger towns usually mean more loot, but they can also mean more zombies and potentially more players, so choose your next destination carefully. To identify a bigger point of interest, refer to its name size. Bigger names are bigger places with a higher building density to explore. Smaller names are smaller villages.

Gear Up
Now that you have picked a destination, try to reach it without triggering a zombie. Find a weapon to allow you to fight back if you need, find food and drinks to stay alive and potentially an outfit to protect you against the weather or against damage.

Armored outfits (police, military, etc…) will offer better protection against damage while temperature proof outfits (firemen, winter coats, etc…) will offer protection against the cold.

If you find wood, make sure to keep it somewhere in your backpack. This is your best chance to survive a cold night in the north.

PvE
Zombies are not the biggest threat, but they can lure your biggest threat if you are not careful! Zombies are usually easy to take down. Aiming for the head will help you get rid of them quickly. But make sure to be quiet as other players may use the noise to locate you and track you down. Unless you are trying to lure players, make sure to use your melee weapon and avoid zombies as much as you can. Being chased around the city is the best way to give up your position when other players get to the area.

PvP
If you encounter other players, it is your choice to avoid them, track them, or try to have a conversation with them. With proximity chat, you can try to convince them to join you, convince them to surrender and handcuff them, or simply shoot them down.
Be careful, because a downed player might turn into a zombie after a bit!
Note that the player does not play as a zombie, but his character returns as a zombie NPC.

Useful Tips

 Holding the menu button (X) will open the map.
 Height calibration cannot be accessed while in the server.
 Smooth/Snap turning can be set from the setting menu.
 Players may turn into zombies after death, watch out!
 Locking the door from the inside will keep it locked for X minutes.
 You can break free from handcuffs by hitting them on a surface, or have someone shoot them off.
 When you go offline, your character is sleeping on the server.
 Containers you can loot will highlight in orange when you reach out to them.
 You can access your outfit menu from the backpack. Clicking the trigger on it works even if you are holding an outfit.
 Jumping and crouching is performed from the pushing right joystick up or down.
 Zombies can chase you indoors, make sure to close doors behind you.
 Some outfits provide better damage protection, while others may provide better protection against cold.
 Starting a fire can be performed in a fireplace by placing a stick bundle in the slot.


We hope you'll enjoy Silent North, if you need any help or have any at all feedback, don't hesitate to reach out on any of the links below for travel guidance!
